interpretation: This evidence belongs only to the frozen source and test inputs identified above. The later cumulative-price, legacy-add admission and warning corrections, together with added regression controls, are verified separately.

Meeting the configured score floors does not establish that every possible fault is detected. Contributor explanations and limits remain as recorded, except the explicitly preserved-and-corrected protective54 numeric review. No universal equivalence claim is made.

Timeouts count toward the existing gate score but retain their raw category. No-test variants are explicit and excluded from that denominator. A raw killed result does not by itself identify an assertion failure.
Targeted later diagnostics do not alter these archived statuses or imply that this run included subsequently added tests.

The configured scope is eighteen modules. Related queue, journal, callback-worker, SDK and bar-buffer paths also have ordinary and integration coverage; this record does not claim direct mutation coverage for every production module.
Recorded environment versions are a subset, not a complete machine attestation. Paper execution and final integrated runtime checks have separate evidence.

known_defects_in_this_frozen_snapshot.description: The latest individual execution price can be mistaken for the cumulative average when earlier fills have different prices and an aligned cumulative average is absent.

A new pyramid add can be admitted against migrated attribution without an ownership epoch, although automated close and protective coordination require that ownership evidence. Historical matched fills must remain reconcilable.

The cost warning can claim existing protection was retained after the old stop was cancelled and a newly unpriced fill prevents replacement. A deferred price plan does not prove current broker coverage.
